summary: Madera County lookout, construction dated to 1928 (the register gives 1934); retired in 1985; on private land; sources disagree on whether it was torn down in 2010.

facts.design: Timber tower with a matching BC-301 cab, two stories per the register; fire-lookouts.org describes three stories
facts.status_note: Sources disagree. The register says it was still standing in 2018; fire-lookouts.org says the owner tore it down in 2010. The site is private land.

access.note: On private land. Fire-lookouts.org says there is no public access; the register says public access is supposed to be restricted.

visit.trail_note: Private land; do not visit without the owner's permission.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (Cal Fire MMU)

events.note: Construction set for June 1928 (newspaper reports, June 16-21) with donated lumber, glass for four sides, and volunteer labor under State Forest Ranger J.E. Wofford; the register gives 1934 and fire-lookouts.org gives about 1938
County and State agree to maintain a lookout on Red Top Mountain; State covers costs above $1,500
Clarence Reed completes the 1933 season (dated November 1, 1933); he is named as the county's lookout in 1934
State forestry division prepares a new road to the station, to make it more accessible to automobiles (November 14, 1942 report)
Ended use as a lookout; tower turned over to the property owner
Fire-lookouts.org says the owner tore it down in 2010; the register says it was still standing in 2018

corrections.why: Madera Tribune reports from June 1928 describe construction being set and started, and the register's own photo caption reads Construction 1928. The lookout was already staffed in 1929 and 1933 to 1934.
The register says still standing in 2018; fire-lookouts.org says the owner tore it down in 2010. Sources conflict and need a field check.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1934 and fire-lookouts.org gives about 1938. The June 1928 newspaper reports and the register's own caption describe construction in 1928, which is the best-supported year.

sources.title: Red Top Fire Lookout, A California Department of Forestry Lookout

notes_for_editor: Status is disputed: the register (2018) and fire-lookouts.org (2010 demolition, page updated 2013) conflict, and no newer source was found. A field check would settle whether the cab still stands. The design is disputed (two stories per the register, three per fire-lookouts.org). The June 1928 newspaper items describe construction as planned and under way; none records completion, so the story says the county set about building the station rather than that it was finished. Not used: a kavelookout.com page titled Red Top Lookout (built 1924, replaced 1928, restored 1996-97, Mount Stuart Range), which appears to be a different lookout. A December 1955 photograph of this lookout is catalogued on archive.org (casbcfm_000714, Cal Fire Museum), but I did not check its image URL or licence, so no photo is recorded. The register lists the lookout as Built 1934; the correction is proposed for human review.
